Alex (Sales): FYI - EdgeWave needs a custom onboarding package: $42,750 one-time credit for security integration + 90-day deferred payments on pilot invoices. Asking to avoid pause while SOC2 work completes. Need quick internal ok.
Elaine (Finance): Amount is $42.75k 3 that's above ops threshold. This will need Director/CFO approval and documented clawback. Is this a billing error or a negotiated concession?
Alex (Sales): Negotiated concession tied to extra security integration they funded. Theycommit to 18mo ARR of $720k if milestones met. Not a system error.
Priya (Acct Ops): Commercial summary: 1) One-off credit $42,750 2) Deferred net90 on pilot invoices only 3) Clawback if they cancel within 6 months (pro rata) 4) Non-precedent clause + SF opp note. Ticket TKT-8122 created.
Elaine (Finance): We need forecasted ARR and NPV impact, GL code, an addendum, and CFO sign-off. Also require revenue ops to mark credits as contra-revenue.
Alex (Sales): Uploaded ARR forecast and migration plan to SF opp 0219-EW. Link in ticket.
Mark (Legal): I'll draft an addendum: limited-term credit, deferred payment schedule, pro-rata clawback if churn <6mo, explicit non-precedent language. Will send to EdgeWave counsel for signature.
billing-bot: Policy alert: credits >$25k require CFO approval. Ticket TKT-8122 flagged.
Elaine (Finance): GL: 6255 - Strategic Onboarding Credits. Approver required: Elaine (Finance) + Bryan (CFO). I'll review the forecast; need Director (RevOps) sign-off too.
Alex (Sales): EdgeWave signed the addendum at 14:42 and returned PDF: https://drive.redwood/deals/edgewave/addendum_signed.pdf
Priya (Acct Ops): SF opp updated with credit schedule. Will only apply deferred net90 window to invoices within pilot dates.
CFO (Bryan): Reviewed forecast and legal addendum. Approve contingent on a 6-month clawback schedule (pro rata) and that credits be booked as contra-revenue. Approved.
Elaine (Finance): Approving one-off credit $42,750 (GL 6255) and deferred Net90 for pilot invoices. Recording memo: "strategic security integration credit - EdgeWave". Posting approval in TKT-8122 and notifying AR to process CRED-2027-992.
billing-bot: Credit scheduled CRED-2027-992 queued. Amount: $42,750. Applied per schedule to INV-2027-2221..2223. Status: queued.
Alex (Sales): Thanks everyone. I'll monitor milestone delivery and ensure clawback triggers are in SF.
Priya (Acct Ops): Noted. I'll add clawback entries and close ticket once credits post.
Elaine (Finance): Closing note: non-precedent, documented in SF opp 0219-EW, GL 6255.
Alex (Sales): Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
